summary: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers, Inc. disclosed in an 8-K the completion of multiple restaurant asset sales. On August 26, 2026, RRI sold 30 Washington/Idaho restaurants to Evergreen Dining LLC for $23.5 million cash. On August 31, 2026, RRI completed the first closing of a sale to Op Burgers, LLC, transferring 61 of 69 restaurants for ~$55.9 million cash, with the remaining eight expected to close before fiscal year-end for ~$6.6 million. Buyers will operate as franchisees under long-term agreements. Watch for second-closing completion and refranchising progress.
